title: Measure greatness by the Life the Guru plants within
summary: The shabad measures greatness by gift: meeting the True Guru enshrines the Lord in the heart, and the Perfect Guru grants the life of the soul. Dignity begins as received life, not public size.
takeaway: Measure greatness by the Life the Guru plants within.
lifeApplication: Before reaching for a larger title, ask whether the heart is actually holding the Lord closer. Let the Guru’s gift define the weight of this day.

source.shortMeaning: Meeting the great True Guru enshrines the Lord in the heart and grants the soul’s life through Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Before chasing stature, ask whether the Guru’s gift is being held close within.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad presents greatness as the Guru’s gift of Naam and soul-life within the heart.
evidence.turn: Let received life weigh more than visible stature.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before reaching for a larger title, ask whether the heart is actually holding the Lord closer. Let the Guru’s gift define the weight of this day.
